The *Sanidassanattika, Āsavasampayuttaduka* (Patthana 16.60) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Within the intricate combinatory system of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text examines the conditional relationships that obtain at the intersection of the *Sanidassanattika* (the triad of visible states) and the *Āsavasampayuttaduka* (the dyad of states associated with defilements or cankers) [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].

No parallel versions in non-Pali corpora (such as Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan) are listed by SuttaCentral or identified by DharmaNexus with significant similarity [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
